Config Audit Resource Get Pac File
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/configAudit/pacFile

Retrieves the PAC file audit report.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
